name: ola-workflow
description: Profile-driven agent workflow: a coordinator dispatches a product designer, a design reviewer, an architect, developers in isolated worktrees and an independent PR reviewer, while GitHub itself keeps merging and the review status with the roles that own them: every agent holds a token that can do neither, and two exact commands get a stronger one. Each project is configured by a profile file, so nothing has to be committed to the project itself.
